name: smwgraphics-goemon-new-age-shutsudou-black-impact-battle
title: Goemon: New Age Shutsudou! - Black Impact Battle
description:
The distant grassland scenary seen during the Black Impact battle from Goemon: New Age Shutsudou! Unlike the original, I took some creative liberties and looped the background so it can be usable in SMW. Uses the last few colors of palette row 6, meaning your blocks are safe!

A good fit for grasslands or "when you are near a castle" level.
